about: Corrections to the imported multiple-choice questions so they agree with the KJV (and BSI Tamil) text the app shows. Applied by scripts/import-bible-mcq.mjs on every build/merge. 'answer' = new index of the right option; 'set' = replace option text [en, ta]; 'q' = replace question [en, ta or null to keep]; 'drop' = remove a question that can't be made fair. 'badTa' = this exact Tamil question is wrong (shows English and goes on the --redo list until a new translation replaces it).
